provenance.summary: Estimated spectral sensitivity of the ALEXA ALEV III sensor (SUP 3.x processing; ALEXA Classic through Mini LF). An estimate, not a measurement.
provenance.method: Curves whose own optimal Academy P-2013-001-style matrices equal ARRI's published native-to-ACES AP0 matrices at 17 CCTs (2000-11000 K), under a 4-component PCA prior built from the 52 measured camera curves in rawtoaces-data (all 52, penalty 1, rawtoaces illuminants). 24-variant ensemble in variants.csv.
inputs: ARRI ALEXA SUP 3.x native-to-ACES AP0 matrices, 17 CCTs, 13 Nov 2013 (aces-dev v1.3.1, ARRI-supplied, AMPAS licence, data/arri/AMPAS-LICENSE.md)
52 measured camera spectral sensitivities and 190 training reflectances (rawtoaces-data, Apache-2.0)
provenance.licence: Apache-2.0 (ours), derived from AMPAS-licensed and Apache-2.0 data; see NOTICE

validation.method: leave-one-camera-out over the 52 measured cameras (training/alexa/validate_loo.py, checked by training/alexa/check_loo.py in .github/workflows/alexa-curve.yml)

caveats: Expected accuracy 3-5 % RFSE for this camera, not the 2.2 % LOO median (research/alexa-ssf/README.md).
Beyond about 660 nm the curve is mostly the prior; treat 660-720 nm as unknown.
Represents ALEXA SUP 3.x / ALEV III processing; not the ALEXA 35 or REVEAL.
Assumes ARRI made its matrices the P-2013-001 way; a different recipe adds error not captured by the leave-one-out test.
